posts.name: wave

slides.label: TODAY'S REMINDER
slides.lead: You don't have to fight the wave.
slides.emphasis: You only have to outlast it.
slides.sub: Every urge rises, peaks and passes. Breathe, and let this one go by.

posts.caption:
An urge feels like it will keep rising until you give in. It won't.

Cravings tend to build, peak and fade, usually within 20 to 30 minutes. Next time one hits, notice where you feel it, breathe, and watch it crest. You don't have to win a fight. You just have to wait it out.

(Source: Bowen et al., JAMA Psychiatry, 2014)

Save this for the next hard moment. 🌊

posts.name: breathe

reel.title: When the urge comes,
reel.closing: It will pass. It always does.

posts.caption:
Try it with us right now: in for 4, hold for 7, out for 8.

Slow breathing tells your body it's safe, and gives the urge time to pass. One round takes less than 20 seconds.

Send this to someone who could use a pause today. 🫁

posts.name: why

slides.label: NAME YOUR WHY
slides.sub: Pick one reason and make it specific. Say it to yourself the next time the urge comes.

posts.caption:
Willpower is a battery. It drains. Your reasons don't.

The people who stay free usually know exactly what they're protecting: a partner, their focus, their faith, the kid who'll copy them one day.

Make yours specific. Not "be better". Something like "be fully present with her."

What's your why? You can keep it to yourself, or share it below. 💬

posts.name: loved-ones

slides.label: FOR THE ONES YOU LOVE
slides.lead: The people in your life get the version of you

posts.caption:
Every time you walk away from the urge, someone wins: your partner, your kids, your friends, your future self.

They get the version of you who's present, rested and fully there.

That's worth fighting for. 💜

posts.name: day-one

slides.label: DAY 1
slides.lead: Every streak starts with one brave day.

posts.caption:
Day 1 is the hardest, and the bravest.

You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to choose today. Tomorrow you can choose again.

If today is your Day 1, drop a 💛 below. We're cheering for you.

posts.name: reset

slides.label: IF THIS WEEK WAS HARD
slides.sub: You're not starting over. You're starting wiser.

posts.caption:
If you slipped this week, read this twice: it doesn't erase what you've built.

Shame keeps the cycle going. Curiosity breaks it. What time was it? How were you feeling? Hungry, angry, lonely, tired?

That's information. Use it, rest, and begin again tomorrow. 🧡
